placements.why: The directives mandate the formal expungement of historical decisions and technical migration knowledge, establishing an organizational category for knowledge lifecycle and governance.
placements.title: Active Governance of Organizational Knowledge and Decision Lifecycles
placements.frame: How does the organization govern the lifecycle, retention, and formal deprecation or expungement of strategic decisions and technical records?

placements.why: Directives to forget the Quantum Widget Decision and remove all knowledge of the PostgreSQL to QuantumDB migration establish a theme of deliberate expungement of historical organizational knowledge.
placements.title: Mandating Intentional Forgetting of Deprecated Technical and Product Decisions
placements.frame: How are obsolete strategic decisions and technical migration records actively expunged from organizational context?
